about: What may be set -- each kind of input tagpup.core.validation declares -- and what each refusal says: [kind, value, expected], null meaning allowed; a value {"repeat": text, "times": n} is the text n times over. Run by tests/test_validation.py against the registry and by tests/frontend/validation.test.mjs against web/common/validate.js, so the server and the pages cannot disagree. "spelled" is how an allowed tag is written once set, by the server and by TagPup's page.
